plan.description: Current runtime promotion: same immutable binary, compiled SVC 0 versus 1, all other current production settings matched. Warm windows, ABBA and BAAB, same host controls as historical reassessment. A modest Snakes cost is acceptable for worthwhile Sky Force gain.

Original current runtime 4a339da9a versus restored compiled SVC default, frozen original 4a harness on both binaries. This includes runtime branch/code-layout costs omitted by same-binary feature comparison. Binary hashes checked; candidate default API separately verified.

Independent recovered candidate toggles in one frozen current-runtime build. SVC enabled in all variants; current production memory and policy matched otherwise. Total artifact comparison required before final adoption.
